name: Banner of Non-combatant
body:
Price 10,000 gp; Aura faint abjuration; CL 5; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

A banner is a flag or heraldry affixed to a pole. The banner is either affixed to a pole which requires two hands to use and cannot be effectively used in combat, or to a piercing polearm weapon. Alternatively, a banner can be affixed to a structure, or to specialized poles that take up a shoulder slot and are affixed to the bearer’s back. The exact imagery on the banner varies widely but is emblematic of the nature of the banner.

While raised, the banner provides a benefit to all those that can see it within 30 feet. If the banner is cast down, all previous beneficiaries are shaken for 10 minutes or until it is raised again.

If the banner is borne by a creature with marshal levels, or the standard-bearer of the banneret archetype, the radius is extended to 60 feet.

All unarmed allies within the radius, including the bearer of the banner if it is not affixed to a polearm, are affected by the sanctuary spell with a DC of 14.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 5,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells sanctuary
